show.description: Flight IC-481 departs from Delhi to Srinagar with ordinary passengers on board. Minutes after takeoff, terrorists led by Dr. Ansari hijack the plane, demanding the release of dreaded militant Yaqub Baba. They threaten to detonate a hidden VX chemical bomb that could kill millions. As panic spreads, a quiet passenger—RAW agent Shitij Bhardwaj, aka White Tiger—must secretly stop the terrorists and save everyone onboard.
